# Cambium Networks

## Families
- ePMP AP and Force subscriber/client devices
- PMP 450 AP/SM
- PTP 450/550/670/700 and licensed PTP 820/850 families (availability varies by generation/region)
- cnWave 60 GHz and 5G Fixed families
- cnMaestro management; LINKPlanner for link planning

## Engineering workflow
1. Select country/regulatory profile, band, product, topology, and link type.
2. Build site coordinates and path profile.
3. Review LoS, Fresnel zone, path loss, received level, fade margin, throughput, and availability.
4. Review antenna, channel, bandwidth, polarization, synchronization, and capacity.
5. Configure both ends consistently where required.
6. Validate registration, RF metrics, Ethernet, VLAN/bridge behavior, throughput, latency, loss, and alarms.

Use current official docs and LINKPlanner. Product capability and CLI/UI differ by model and software release.
